title: Free Token Airdrop
subtitle: Claim 10,000 FREE tokens

messages.text:

Congratulations! You've been selected for the FREE-TOKEN community airdrop! Tap 'Claim' to activate your tokens and add them to your tradeable balance.

choices.revealText: Sensei says: Free tokens that appear out of nowhere? Classic honeypot. They WANT you to interact with the contract. Check what permissions it's actually asking for before you click anything!

messages.text:

Permission requested:
• Token Approval: UNLIMITED ♾️
• Tokens: ALL TOKENS IN WALLET

Estimated Gas: 0.003 ETH

choices.text: Reject — this approval is too broad

messages.text:
📋 Contract Analysis:
• Token has no liquidity pool — you can't actually sell it
• The 'Claim' function doesn't give you tokens — it requests an UNLIMITED approval
• With unlimited approval, the contract owner can drain every token you hold
• Contract is unverified, deployed 1 day ago
🚨 VERDICT: This is a honeypot! The 'free tokens' are worthless bait. The real attack is the unlimited approval — once granted, the scammer drains your real tokens.

choices.text: Reject and hide this scam token

passiveClues: You never signed up for this airdrop — the tokens appeared uninvited
The contract is requesting UNLIMITED approval for ALL your tokens
FREE-TOKEN has no liquidity — it's untradeable
The contract was deployed only 1 day ago and is unverified

activeInvestigations.result: Contract source code is unverified. The 'claim' function doesn't distribute tokens — it calls 'approve(spender, type(uint256).max)' which grants the owner unlimited access to drain your wallet.
The FREE-TOKEN contract was deployed 1 day ago. It has 0 liquidity on all DEXes. The deployer wallet has been flagged on Etherscan for previous scam tokens.
Multiple reports on Twitter and Reddit: 'FREE-TOKEN is a honeypot scam. DO NOT interact with it. If you already approved, revoke immediately using revoke.cash.'

howItWorked.text: Scammer airdropped worthless tokens to thousands of wallets for free
The 'Claim' button didn't actually give you tokens — it triggered a token approval transaction
The approval was set to UNLIMITED, meaning the contract could spend ALL your real tokens
Once approved, the scammer's bot automatically drains your valuable tokens within seconds

redFlags: Receiving tokens you never signed up for
Any transaction requesting UNLIMITED token approval
Tokens with no liquidity pool — you can't sell them anyway
Contracts deployed very recently with unverified source code
The 'claim' action requiring a wallet approval instead of just transferring tokens
irlProtection: Never interact with tokens you didn't expect to receive — just ignore them
Always read what a transaction is actually asking you to approve before confirming
If an approval says 'UNLIMITED' or a very large number, that's a major red flag
Use revoke.cash or Etherscan token approval checker to review and revoke suspicious approvals
Legitimate airdrops deposit tokens directly — they don't require you to 'claim' with an approval
